verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page describes built-in AI agents: you describe a control, and they collect, validate, and package the evidence on a schedule using APIs and browser workflows. That is real in-product delegation, but only for evidence collection, and only on marketing pages. The MCP/OAuth docs cover connecting external assistants, which is not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant for delegating tasks beyond evidence collection, in-depth docs on how Fieldwork agents are invoked and what they can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Fieldwork uses APIs and browser workflows to access evidence from your connectors.
